parts.style: Young builder making a fast tech reel, straight into a phone mic. Leaning in close, punchy, a little smug like he's about to share a secret. Neutral international English.
parts.text: Seven Claude Code shortcuts almost nobody uses. <short pause> And number seven saves me hours.

parts.style: Brisk list with a vocal smile, quick and bouncy, no dead air. Each number lands hard and short, then the tip rolls out fast. Neutral international English.
parts.text: One. Slash init. Claude reads your repo and writes its own Claude dot M-D file. Two. The at sign. Type at, then a file name, and that file drops straight into context. Three. Exclamation mark. Run any terminal command right inside the chat. Four. Shift Tab. That's plan mode. Claude plans first, and touches nothing. Five. Escape. It stops Claude the second it goes the wrong way. Six. Slash compact. It shrinks a long chat, so you keep going.

parts.style: The payoff, slightly bigger energy, like the best one is finally here. Neutral international English.
parts.text: And seven. Type claude, dash C. <short pause> It reopens your last chat, exactly where you left it.

parts.style: Warm, direct sign-off with a grin, a touch slower. Neutral international English.
parts.text: Save this before your next session.
